content.short: Launchpad that turns a social post into an ERC-20 token traded on a bonding curve.
content.description: Astro Pump lets someone tokenize a social media post: the author proves ownership, mints an ERC-20 for it, and the token trades on a bonding curve until it has raised enough to migrate to a DEX. Launches pass through a pre-bond stage first, and buyers can claim a refund if a project never completes. It is available on several EVM networks, Unichain among them.
content.meta: Astro Pump tokenizes social posts as ERC-20s that trade on a bonding curve and graduate to a DEX, with refunds if a launch fails.
